description: Locale info (CLDR) — Everything an app or agent needs to localize for a BCP 47 locale, offline from Unicode CLDR: canonical tag, likely script/region (maximize/minimize), language/region/script names in English (or display=fr etc.) and in the native language, text direction, first day of week + weekend days, 12/24-hour clock, default and available calendars, numbering systems, collations, IANA time zones for the region, region currency (ISO 4217, name, local symbol), decimal/group separators, date/time patterns (e.g. M/d/yy, dd.MM.yy), plural categories (cardinal + ordinal), measurement system, paper size (Letter vs A4), and formatted samples (number, percent, compact, currency, dates, time, relative time, lists). Params: locale= (required; en-US, pt-BR, zh-Hant-TW, sr-Latn-RS, ja-JP-u-ca-japanese; underscores accepted; comma-separate up to 5), display= (language for names, default en). 400 on a malformed tag. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_locale
